name: Fried bamboo grubs
summary: Bamboo grubs fried with lime leaf, the plate Vietnamnet, on 16 March 2019, calls the common one among Thái đen preparations. The grubs are nearly two finger joints long and white, in young bamboo on the northwest slopes, most numerous in early autumn. The article also names stir-fry with sour bamboo, a crisp fry, steaming, and steaming in a basket, and says the lime-leaf fry is the one people order. It calls that fry crisp, rich, and fragrant.
